Title: Generally available: Apache MirrorMaker 2 support in Azure Event Hubs

Body.Content: With the general availability of Apache Kafka Compaction and Connect API compatibility of Azure Event Hubs, users now can utilize MirrorMaker2 for effortless data replication from their on-premises or managed Kafka cluster directly to Event Hubs.
